<DOCSTRING>
Logs whether a user is an adult or a minor based on their age.

@summary Determines if a user is an adult and logs the result.
@description This function checks if the provided user is an adult (age 18 or older) and logs a message indicating whether the user is an adult or a minor.
@returns {void} No value is returned. The function logs the user's status to the console.
@throws {Error} This function does not throw any errors.
</DOCSTRING>
